content: Lash service durations (BR sources, cross-checked across 3+ salon and blog sources): Classico (fio a fio, 80-150 fios por olho) around 2h full application. Volume Russo (500-700 fios por olho, leques de 2-6 fios) around 2h30-3h+ due to complexity. Hibrido (mix of classico and russo, 80-150+ fios por olho) around 2h average, varies by professional pace. Manutencao (fill or touch-up) performed every 15-20 days (up to 3-4 weeks outer bound), shorter duration than full application, typically 1-1.5h, implied by scope reduction rather than directly sourced.
